title: parseTrackerModelSpec
responsibility: List the automatic Tracker models and resolve explicit pins with the applicable effort defaults.

inputs.name: ladderFrom.config
inputs.description: Optional configuration overriding matching default ladder entries.

inputs.name: parseTrackerModelSpec.spec
inputs.description: Model name or alias with an optional reasoning effort suffix.

inputs.name: parseTrackerModelSpec.ladder
inputs.description: Current ladder entries and their model and effort defaults.

outputs.name: solEfforts
outputs.description: Supported Sol reasoning efforts in increasing order.

outputs.name: ladderFrom
outputs.description: Automatic model catalog with eligible matching overrides and fixed Sonnet and Opus defaults.

outputs.name: parseTrackerModelSpec
outputs.description: Validated pinned model and effort selected from the explicit model specification.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: The model specification, version, or effort is invalid for the requested pin.
